LanguageData.CC_Count_DayOff_Desc: Give {PAWN_nameDef} a day off: for a day {PAWN_possessive} work hours are free time and the first hours after {PAWN_pronoun} wakes a lie-in, so {PAWN_pronoun} rests, takes {PAWN_possessive} recreation, walks and sees friends, and does no ordinary work (a fire or someone needing a doctor still comes first). Strain eases faster while it runs and more when it runs its course. It ends early if danger comes. Once in five days for each colonist.
LanguageData.CC_Count_DayOff_EndDesc: Bring {PAWN_nameDef} back to work now: {PAWN_possessive} timetable goes back as it was, and the day off counts for half.
LanguageData.CC_Count_DayOff_CardTip: A day of rest away from work, for someone strained: it eases strain well beyond an ordinary day, and the colony goes a day without their work.

LanguageData.CC_Settings_HeartBands: How strongly the bands are felt
LanguageData.CC_Settings_HeartBands_Tip: How much the heart's bands move a colonist's mood. Felt (the default): strained -4, worn down -8, near breaking -14; steady +3, in good heart +6, in high spirits +10. Mild, as before the heart was made to count: -3, -5, -8 and +2, +3, +5. Strong: -5, -10, -18 and +4, +8, +13. These go through the game's own mood, so the worn down break more often, as they should; the good side grows ordinary like any good mood.
LanguageData.CC_HeartBands_Mild_Tip: Strained -3, worn down -5, near breaking -8; the good side +2, +3, +5.
LanguageData.CC_HeartBands_Felt_Tip: Strained -4, worn down -8, near breaking -14; the good side +3, +6, +10.
LanguageData.CC_HeartBands_Strong_Tip: Strained -5, worn down -10, near breaking -18; the good side +4, +8, +13.
LanguageData.CC_SetNote_HeartBands_Mild: The bands barely show in mood, as before.
LanguageData.CC_SetNote_HeartBands_Felt: Worn down is a real weight on mood, and in good heart a real lift.
LanguageData.CC_SetNote_HeartBands_Strong: The heart decides much of a mood: the worn down break noticeably more often.
LanguageData.CC_Settings_HeartEffects_Tip: Strain and the good side touch more than mood, mildly: work 3% slower when strained, 7% when worn down and 12% near breaking; the worn down learn up to a tenth slower, need a little more sleep, heal up to a tenth slower and fight off illness up to 5% slower; in good heart and in high spirits a little faster learning, healing and immunity. Each shows in the stat's own explanation and on the heart's page. Off: only the old work slowdown from worn down (5% and 10%).
LanguageData.CC_SetNote_HeartEffects: Work, learning, sleep and recovery feel the heart, a little.
LanguageData.CC_Settings_HeartBadDays_Tip: Now and then someone worn down has a bad afternoon: off work for a few hours, a while in their room, a walk, a drink if they drink and their policy and faith allow it, a visit to a grave. Only when it's safe (no danger, enough hands, nobody left uncared for), at most once a week for each colonist and once in two days in the colony; it ends early if danger comes, and eases a good share of their strain. A message says why.
LanguageData.CC_SetNote_HeartBadDays: The worn down sometimes leave their work for an afternoon.
LanguageData.CC_Settings_HeartSpread_Tip: Someone worn down wears a little on those close to them (a partner, kin, a friend), and someone in high spirits lifts them a little. Small, within its own cap, and never past strained on its own: one worn colonist can't wear the colony down.
LanguageData.CC_SetNote_HeartSpread: A worn partner wears on you a little; a friend in high spirits lifts you.
LanguageData.CC_Settings_HeartAdvice_Tip: For each strained colonist, the few things that would ease them most, from what is wearing on them now and what the colony has: a day off, a decree of the council's that eases strain (with what it costs), a gathering, time with a friend, a proper meal, a better bed, recreation, their pain treated, a rest from fighting. On the Mood tab, their card, the council's Moods page and the message when someone is worn down, each with a button where Rimfolk can do it.
LanguageData.CC_SetNote_HeartAdvice: Advice you can act on, with a button where Rimfolk can do it.
LanguageData.CC_Settings_HeartDayOff: A day off for one colonist
LanguageData.CC_Settings_HeartDayOff_Tip: Give a strained colonist a day off from their Mood tab, their card, the advice or a button on them: for a day they rest, sleep in, take their recreation, walk and see friends, and do no ordinary work. It eases strain well beyond an ordinary day; the colony goes a day without their work. Once in five days for each colonist, and it ends early if danger comes.
LanguageData.CC_SetNote_HeartDayOff: A button for a strained colonist's day off.
